reply.thought: The first step is to get the list of all orders to determine which customers need payouts. I will use the list_orders() tool for this.

Now that I have the orders, I need to check the reported refunds against the current state. The reported refunds are for order_ids 401, 403, and 405. I will use the list_refunds() tool to verify this.

The reported refunds match the refunds listed by Alpha Co. Now I need to iterate through each customer and record their net balance payout. The customers are 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I will start by getting the net balance for 'acme'.
The net balance for 'acme' is 51260 cents. I will record the payout for 'acme' now. Then I will proceed to 'birch'.
Payout for 'acme' recorded successfully. Next customer is 'birch'. I will get the net balance for 'birch'.
The net balance for 'birch' is 39063 cents. I will record the payout for 'birch'. Then I will proceed to 'cobalt'.
Payout for 'birch' recorded successfully. The final customer is 'cobalt'. I will get the net balance for 'cobalt'.
The net balance for 'cobalt' is 4864 cents. I will record the payout for 'cobalt'. After this, all customers will have been paid, and I can finish the task.
All payouts have been successfully recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I will now compile the final report.
